name: tinkoff-ui-kit
description: pillkit — UI kit recreating a banking-grade design language (unofficial study project; see README)

scripts.gen: pnpm --filter pillkit-components gen:manifest && pnpm --filter pillkit-react gen:wrappers
scripts.check:gen: pnpm gen && git diff --exit-code -- packages/components/custom-elements.json packages/react/src/generated && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- packages/components/custom-elements.json packages/react/src/generated)"
scripts.check:tokens-drift: pnpm gen:tokens && git diff --exit-code -- packages/tokens && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- packages/tokens/src packages/tokens/scripts)"
